source_text: Design a compact desktop lifting box. The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform. The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm and support a payload of approximately 1 kg. The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing. The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture. Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.
product_intent: A compact desktop device with an enclosed lifting mechanism operated manually via a hand crank that raises and lowers an internal platform by approximately 80-100 mm while supporting approximately 1 kg of payload.
user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop lifting box that uses a hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform by 80-100 mm, supporting 1 kg of payload.

clauses.text: Design a compact desktop lifting box.
The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform.
The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm and support a payload of approximately 1 kg.
The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing.
The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.
Continuous or intermittent lifting is acceptable.
Multiple shafts, bearings, guides, and supports are allowed.

requirements.statement: The product must enable a user to rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform.

verification.observable: platform motion when hand crank is rotated

requirements.statement: The internal platform must lift approximately 80-100 mm.

The mechanism must be enclosed inside the housing.

operating_scenarios.name: Manual operation with hand crank
operating_scenarios.description: User rotates external hand crank to lift or lower the internal platform in either direction.

operating_scenarios.name: Platform lifting within specified range
operating_scenarios.description: Platform lifts or lowers between 80-100 mm during operation.

operating_scenarios.name: Payload support requirement
operating_scenarios.description: Platform supports up to 1 kg of payload without failure.

operating_scenarios.name: Enclosed mechanism operation
operating_scenarios.description: All mechanical components are enclosed within the housing structure.

operating_scenarios.name: Safety and stability requirements
operating_scenarios.description: Product operates safely without jamming or unstable behavior.

relations.rationale: Platform lift height depends on crank rotation mechanism
